jobs.description:
Overview Of The Role: 

 The Head of FP&A and Pricing is responsible for the consolidation and review of financial data, ensuring accurate reporting, and managing pricing strategies vital for revenue generation in leasing and lending portfolios. The role demands strong leadership in directing FP&A activities, optimizing pricing processes, and providing insights that drive decision-making for both B2B and B2C segments within the Financial Services division. With oversight of significant financial dimensions and resources, this position plays a crucial role in supporting strategic financial and pricing decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, and adhering to financial governance standards.
 
 What You Will Do: 

 Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) 
 Manage FP&A activities across FS division, including review of budgets and forecasts for all FS entities.
 Prepare and review monthly FRM deck, explaining key variances at consolidated or entity level.
 Develop financial consolidation processes to ensure fairness and accuracy in financial reporting with Group Finance.
 
 Pricing Management 
 Review and align tender requirements and pricing simulation files with management along with contract financials.
 Develop and standardize pricing calculators for use by the Sales & Operations team.
 Manage the governance of pricing activities including margin control and pricing policies.
 Review pricing processes to ensure accuracy, fairness, and reduction of turnaround times across FS entities globally.
 Oversee automated lease rate calculators for different channels to reduce turnaround times and assist sales in closing deals quicker.
 
 Process Governance & Reporting 
 Manage the system governance from a control and Delegation of Authority (DoA) perspective.
 Prepare dashboards providing visibility to management about wins/losses, revenue, and margins earned monthly.
 Ensure compliance with Group deadlines for required submissions and approvals.
 Mentor junior team members or analysts and influence decisions without direct authority.

 Required Skills To Be Successful: 

 Strong financial acumen and analytical capabilities.
 Ability to develop and manage automated financial tools and calculators.
 Proficiency in financial reporting systems like SAP and SAC.
 Demonstrated leadership in mentoring and influencing teams.
 
 What Qualifies You For The Role: 

 CA/CWA/CMA/MBA with a strong finance background.
 Minimum 12 years of experience, with over 5 years in a senior leadership role.
 Proficiency in SAP, SAC, and other reporting systems.
 Excellent communication, analytical, and interpersonal skills.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID: 179448 

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate. 

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day

 Healthcare Finance Experience is Essential 

HealthHub, part of Al-Futtaim Health, is seeking an experienced Head of Healthcare Finance to lead the financial performance, strategic planning, and commercial finance activities of our growing healthcare business.

Reporting directly to the Managing Director, this senior leadership role will partner closely with operational and clinical leaders to drive performance across our network of community-based outpatient clinics, healthcare services, diagnostic operations, and future hospital expansion initiatives.

 Applicants without significant healthcare finance experience will not be considered. 

We are specifically seeking candidates who have held senior finance leadership positions within hospitals, healthcare groups, clinic networks, medical centres, day surgery facilities, or other healthcare providers.

 About the Role 

 This is not a traditional accounting or reporting role. 

We are looking for a commercially focused healthcare finance leader who understands the operational realities of delivering healthcare services and can translate financial information into meaningful business decisions.

The successful candidate will have experience supporting multi-site healthcare operations and working directly with executives, physicians, operational leaders, and corporate stakeholders.

You will play a key role in shaping financial strategy, supporting healthcare growth initiatives, improving operational performance, and ensuring strong financial governance across the business.

 Key Responsibilities 

Healthcare Financial Performance
Drive financial performance across clinics and healthcare business units
Partner with operational leaders to improve profitability and operational efficiency
Monitor physician productivity, revenue trends, patient volumes, service line performance, and payer mix
Identify opportunities to improve financial and operational outcomes
Support business growth and healthcare service development initiatives

 Financial Planning & Strategy 

Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning processes
Develop financial models and strategic business cases
Support new clinic developments, healthcare expansion projects, and future hospital initiatives
Deliver meaningful financial insights and recommendations to executive leadership
Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic growth initiatives
Governance & Controls
Ensure robust financial controls, compliance, governance, and audit readiness
Oversee monthly management reporting and financial performance reviews
Manage statutory requirements and external audit relationships
Support risk management and business continuity initiatives

 Leadership 

Lead and develop a high-performing finance team
Foster a culture of accountability, partnership, and continuous improvement
Act as a trusted advisor to executive and operational leadership teams

 Essential Requirements 

Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline
Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, or CFA
Minimum 10 years of progressive finance experience
Minimum 5 years in a senior finance leadership position
Extensive Healthcare Finance Experience Within:
Hospitals
Healthcare Groups
Medical Centres
Clinic Networks
Day Surgery Centres
Multi-site Healthcare Operations
Demonstrated Experience In:
Healthcare Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)
Healthcare business partnering
Healthcare operations finance
Physician productivity analysis
Revenue cycle and healthcare KPIs
Payer mix analysis
Multi-site healthcare performance management
Business case development and healthcare investments
Candidates Unlikely to Be Suitable

 This position is not intended for candidates whose experience is primarily within: 

Banking
Manufacturing
FMCG
Retail
Construction
Audit-only environments
Corporate FP&A without healthcare operations exposure

Applicants must be able to demonstrate direct experience supporting healthcare delivery businesses.

 What's on Offer 

Senior leadership role reporting directly to the Managing Director
Significant influence over financial and operational strategy
Exposure to healthcare expansion and future hospital development projects
Opportunity to work alongside experienced clinical and operational leaders
Competitive executive compensation and benefits package
Long-term career growth within one of the UAE's most respected healthcare organizations

 About Al-Futtaim Healthcare 

 We Hear Your Ambition. 

For over 90 years, the Al-Futtaim Group has been bringing the world’s leading brands of lifestyle watches, cars, home furnishings and fashion to the UAE. The Group has now introduced a whole new way of holistic healthcare through HealthHub Clinics by Al-Futtaim, its multi-speciality chain of more than 20 clinics in Dubai with over 25 specialties offering the right combination of advanced diagnostics, proven medical expertise and specialised services . 

What gives our clinics an edge is that as a part of the Al-Futtaim Group, you can expect world-class quality standards, with access to the best medical services and facilities within a healing environment. It’s a new way of healthcare that’s designed to meet a patient’s needs with a complete range of smart healthcare solutions. As testimony to this, only recently, we’ve earned a rare milestone of being the only primary healthcare network in the UAE to receive the Gold Seal by a reputed international body: Accreditation Canada. 

As trusted partners to health, we at HealthHub Clinics adopt evidence-based learning that enables us to listen to our patients more carefully. It helps us in treating the cause and not just the symptoms, while applying global best practices to ensure quality of care for every family member. Most of all, we adopt a patient-centric approach to healthcare that is reflected in the promise of our core belief: “ We Hear You. ”

jobs.title: Vice President – Asset Management (Commercial)
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE
Lead the strategic management of Aldar's assigned commercial assets to maximize portfolio value, optimize financial performance, and enhance customer experience. Drive asset performance through leasing strategy, capital investment, service provider governance, sustainability initiatives, and cross-functional collaboration while supporting Aldar's long-term investment objectives.
The role is for the UAE national
 
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Strategic Asset & Portfolio Management
Develop and implement asset strategies to maximize long-term value and portfolio performance.
Drive portfolio optimization through asset repositioning, enhancement, and capital recycling initiatives.
Monitor market trends and asset performance to support strategic decision-making.
2. Financial Performance & Capital Management
Manage portfolio financial performance, including NOI, occupancy, yield, valuation, and total return.
Identify value creation opportunities and oversee annual business planning, budgeting, and financial reporting.
Support investment decisions through financial analysis and performance insights.
3. Leasing, Commercialisation & Tenant Experience
Lead leasing strategies to maximize occupancy, rental growth, and tenant retention.
Identify commercialisation opportunities and oversee tenant engagement initiatives to improve customer satisfaction and NPS.
Review key leasing transactions and ensure alignment with portfolio objectives.
4. Asset Enhancement & Development Coordination
Lead asset enhancement programmes and CAPEX initiatives to improve asset performance and customer experience.
Coordinate with Development, Legal, Finance, and Operations to ensure successful project delivery and asset handover.
Monitor post-completion performance against approved business cases.
5. Service Provider Governance
Oversee the performance of Property and Facilities Management service providers through agreed SLAs, KPIs, and governance frameworks.
Drive continuous improvement, operational excellence, and cost optimization across the portfolio.
6. Stakeholder & Portfolio Collaboration
Partner with internal business units, including Development, Finance, Legal, Retail, Hospitality, and Education, to deliver integrated portfolio initiatives.
Build and maintain effective relationships with tenants, brokers, consultants, contractors, and external stakeholders.
 
RELATED YEARS OF EXPERIENCE
Min of 10+ years of at least 5 years of experience in real estate, property and asset management, investment banking, buy side or sell side advisory or other related field.
 
YOE IN MANAGERIAL POSITION
Min of 2+ years in a related managerial position
 
FIELD OF EXPERIENCE
Banking, real estate consultancy, management consultancy.
 
TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS
Outstanding analytical and quantitative skills; proficiency with standard software, including MS Office; advanced Excel skills is a must.
Proven track record in conducting valuation / financial models.
Able to analyze, evaluate and move quickly to support rapid decision making.
Ability to interpret and manage transaction documentation: NDAs, MoUs, LoI’s, and SPA’s
Ability to develop Board level papers and investment memoranda.
 
QUALIFICATION
Bachelor Degree in Engineering, Economics, Finance or Accounting, MBA (Finance), CFA, CA or CPA preferred.

jobs.normalized_title: senior finance manager fashion watches and jewelry
jobs.description:
INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

What you'll be doing

As the Senior Finance Manager – Joint Ventures (Fashion & Jewelry), you will act as the strategic finance partner for a portfolio of leading international luxury brands across the Middle East, including Fendi, Givenshy, Louis Vuitton, Celine, Loewe, Repossi, De Beers, Max Mara, Zimmermann, Christian Louboutin, Marni, Jil Sander,Kenzo, and Maison Margiela.

You will work closely with Executive Management, Brand Partners, and Joint Venture leadership teams to drive profitable growth, support strategic investments, enhance shareholder value, and provide financial leadership across the full business lifecycle.

The role combines business partnering, corporate finance, FP&A, governance, business development, and executive-level stakeholder management, requiring both strong analytical capabilities and commercial acumen.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Business Partnering

  • Serve as the primary finance partner for the Fashion & Jewelry Joint Venture portfolio.

  • Partner with Joint Venture Finance Teams, and Chalhoub Executive Management to support strategic decision-making.

  • Challenge business assumptions and provide independent, data-driven recommendations.

  • Drive value creation initiatives focused on profitability, cash generation, and return on investment.

  • Support negotiations with international luxury brand partners on strategic and financial matters.

Financial Planning & Performance Management

  • Lead the annual budget, rolling forecast, and long-term planning processes.

  • Monitor financial performance against Budget, Forecast and Prior Year, identifying risks and opportunities.

  • Perform detailed variance analysis and translate financial results into actionable business insights.

  • Drive initiatives to improve revenue growth, profitability, cash flow and working capital.

Corporate Finance & Financial Modelling

  • Build robust financial models to support:

    • New Joint Venture opportunities

    • Business development projects

    • Store investment decisions

    • Valuation exercises

    • M&A and shareholder transactions

  • Develop integrated financial models including:

    • Profit & Loss

    • Balance Sheet

    • Cash Flow

    • Enterprise Value

    • IRR, NPV and Payback analysis

  • Evaluate investment opportunities and prepare financial recommendations for Executive Management.

Governance & Executive Reporting

  • Prepare high-quality financial presentations for senior leadership and shareholders.

  • Present financial analyses and strategic recommendations to senior executives.

  • Ensure consistency, accuracy and transparency of financial reporting across the portfolio.

  • Support Joint Venture governance, shareholder reporting and Board decision-making processes.

Financial Systems & Process Improvement

  • Continuously improve financial reporting processes, planning tools and analytical capabilities.

  • Drive automation and process efficiencies across finance activities.

  • Ensure strong financial controls and high standards of data integrity.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance operational effectiveness.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • You hold a Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related discipline.

  • You preferably hold an MBA and/or professional qualification (CPA, ACCA, CFA or CMA).

  • You possess a minimum of 10 years of progressive finance experience, including significant exposure to FP&A, business partnering or corporate finance.

  • You preferably have experience within luxury retail, retail, FMCG or consumer goods.

  • You preferably have previous exposure to Joint Ventures, multinational organizations or matrix environments.

  • You are adapt in financial planning, budgeting and forecasting.

  • You possess advanced financial modelling and valuation skills.

  • You have a solid understanding of IFRS and financial reporting.

  • You possess strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

  • You have advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with ERP and BI tools is an advantage.

  • You possess excellent communication and presentation skills and the ability to influence senior stakeholders through credible financial insights.

  • You have a commercial mindset with a strong focus on value creation.

  • You are a strategic thinker capable of balancing long-term vision with operational execution.

  • You have excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

  • You have the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, international environment.

  • You possess a high level of ownership, integrity and attention to detail.

What makes this role unique

jobs.title: Senior Vice President – Commercial Strategy and Analysis
jobs.normalized_title: senior vice president commercial strategy and analysis
jobs.description:
Job Purpose: 

 •Lead the development and execution of Aldar Development’s Commercial strategy, ensuring full alignment with the company’s broader objectives and long-term goals.

 •Establish a data-driven culture within Commercial, spearheading analytics and BI to inform decision-making, performance monitoring, and strategic planning.

 •Serve as the key strategic partner to the Chief Commercial Officer, translating market intelligence and performance data into actionable business strategies.

 Job Responsibilities: 

 Strategy Development & Execution 

 •Develop and lead Aldar Development’s overall Commercial strategy, integrating inputs across Sales, CX, Marketing, and Operations.

 •Cascade the Commercial strategy to all business units, ensuring alignment and assisting in developing departmental scorecards and strategic initiatives.

 •Lead strategic planning processes including market assessments, financial modelling, and competitive analysis.

 •Drive digital transformation and innovation initiatives within the Commercial function.

 •Act as primary contact for senior leadership on commercial strategy, performance, and operational improvements.

 Data Analysis & Performance Monitoring 

 •Establish and maintain a robust data analytics and business intelligence capability across Commercial.

 •Oversee commercial forecasting, providing accurate revenue projections, budgets, and scenario planning.

 •Ensure availability, accuracy, and timeliness of data, dashboards, and performance reports for commercial leadership.

 •Monitor market trends, competitive dynamics, and macroeconomic conditions to identify opportunities and risks.

 •Champion the use of BI tools (Tableau, Power BI, CRM analytics) across the function.

 Reporting & Stakeholder Management 

 •Prepare and present regular commercial performance reports and strategic insights to the CCO and senior leadership.

 •Track key financial and non-financial KPIs including revenue performance, NPS, and sales efficiency.

 •Ensure Commercial activities operate within budget while maximizing ROI.

 • Partner with Group Strategy on consolidated reporting, target-setting, and manpower planning.

 Years of Experience: 

 •Min 12+ years of strategy and analytics experience in a large multinational company, real estate firm, or top-tier management consultancy. Deep expertise in strategy deployment frameworks and GCC real estate market dynamics.

 YoE in Managerial Position 

 •Min 4+ years of managerial experience leading strategy and analytics teams.

 Field of Experience 

 •Management Consulting / Real Estate / Strategy. Strong GCC market knowledge essential.

 Technical and Interpersonal Skills 

 •Expertise in strategy development and balanced scorecard frameworks.

jobs.title: Finance Manager
jobs.description:
INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

What you'll be doing  

As a Finance Manager, you will act as the key finance partner for one of our brands, ensuring strong financial control, accurate reporting, and commercial insight to support day-to-day trading decisions. The role will also play a critical part in setting up and supporting a new strategic project, ensuring financial discipline, scalability, and strong governance from inception. This role is highly operational and hands-on, with close interaction across finance, operations, and commercial teams to drive performance and profitability.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Act as the primary business finance partner for the brand, ensuring strong financial control, accurate reporting, and commercial insight to support day-to-day operations.

  • Partner closely with Planning, Retail, GM and Ecommerce teams to support decision-making and drive overall business performance.

  • Manage financial reporting including weekly, monthly, and ad-hoc performance analysis across sales, margin, and inventory.

  • Monitor and drive profitability across the liquidation business, ensuring tight control over costs, pricing, and stock efficiency.

  • Support forecasting and budgeting processes, ensuring alignment with commercial plans and trading performance.

  • Provide financial input into operational and trading decisions, ensuring data-led decision-making across all channels.

  • Support the end-to-end setup and financial governance of a new strategic project, ensuring scalability and control from launch.

  • Identify risks and opportunities across trading performance and proactively recommend corrective actions.

  • Improve and streamline financial processes to support a fast-moving, high-volume operational business.

  • Deliver clear, actionable insights to senior stakeholders to influence strategy and execution.

What you’ll need to succeed  

  • You hold a degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field.

  • You preferably hold a professional qualification such as ACCA, CA, CMA.

  • You possess 3 to 5 years of experience in finance, ideally within retail, trading, FMCG, or high-volume operational environments.

  • You have a strong understanding of P&L management, inventory accounting, and margin analysis.

  • You have experience working in fast-paced, commercially driven businesses with tight operational cycles.

  • You have the ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable business insights.

  • You possess strong Excel and financial modelling skills; experience with SAP systems and Looker is a plus.

  • You have a proven ability to partner with non-finance stakeholders, especially operations teams.

  • You are comfortable working in a hands-on, execution-focused role with high levels of ambiguity.

  • You have experience supporting or leading project-based work or new business launches.

  • You are a strong communicator with the ability to influence stakeholders and drive accountability.

What we can offer you  

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality.  We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.  

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.  

Using GenAI in Your Application Process

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

 Job Purpose 

 The Assistant Vice President - Compliance is responsible for supporting the VP-Compliance in ensuring the Company’s adherence to applicable regulatory requirements, with primary responsibility for compliance matters relating to health insurance and the requirements of the Dubai Health Authority (DHA) and Department of Health (DOH) in Abu Dhabi. 

 The role will also support VP- Compliance in the implementation and monitoring of the Company’s overall compliance framework and in handling other matters as assigned. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 1. Health Insurance Regulatory Compliance – Primary Responsibility 

 Review products, policy terms, underwriting, enrolment, claims, pre-authorization, reimbursement and complaints for regulatory compliance. 

 Oversee compliance risks relating to provider networks, brokers, outsourcing partners and TPAs, including due diligence, contracts, service levels, data access and audit rights. 

 Monitor laws, regulations, standards, circulars, notices and other requirements issued by the Dubai Health Authority (DHA) and the Department of Health in Abu Dhabi and ensure coordination with the above authorities. 

 Coordinate with Health Insurance, Claims, Underwriting, Operations, IT and other relevant departments to ensure timely implementation of regulatory requirements. 

 Maintain an updated register of applicable health insurance regulatory requirements and monitor the Company’s compliance with such requirements. 

 Review health insurance policies and procedures from a regulatory compliance perspective. 

 Support the preparation and submission of regulatory reports, responses, confirmations and other information required by the relevant health authorities. 

 Coordinate and follow up on regulatory inspections, reviews, audits, observations and remediation actions relating to health insurance. 

 Monitor regulatory deadlines and ensure that required actions and submissions are completed within the prescribed timelines. 

 Escalate material compliance issues, regulatory breaches or implementation delays to the VP- Compliance. 

 Promote fair customer outcomes and transparent disclosures in health insurance activities and monitor health insurance complaints from a regulatory compliance perspective. 

 Provide compliance support in relation to financial crime controls and medical-fraud investigations; advise on privacy, consent, confidentiality, retention and health-data sharing. 

 2. Compliance Monitoring and Assurance 

 Execute risk-based reviews, report findings, establish accountable actions, validate closure and escalate material breaches. 

 Maintain appropriate documentation and evidence demonstrating compliance with applicable regulatory requirements. 

 Follow up with business units on agreed compliance remediation actions and report overdue or material matters to the VP- Compliance. 

 Assist VP- Compliance in preparing compliance reports, maintain regulatory records, deliver targeted training and support enterprise-wide compliance initiatives. 

 3. General Compliance Support 

 Monitor compliance with applicable insurance laws, regulations, standards and regulatory circulars. 

 Conduct regulatory gap assessments and support implementation of new regulatory requirements. 

 Review internal policies, procedures, products, agreements and business initiatives from a compliance perspective. 

 Support the preparation and updating of the Compliance Framework, Compliance Plan and related policies and procedures. 

 Perform any other compliance-related duties assigned by the VP- Compliance. 

 Qualifications and Experience 

 Bachelor’s degree in law, Finance, Business, Insurance, Healthcare Administration or a related field; relevant professional qualification preferred. 

 Typically, 10–12 years’ relevant experience, including 5 years in a managerial or senior advisory role.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Manager
jobs.description:
INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM. Their collective efforts have earned the Group the Great Place to Work® certification in several markets.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

What you'll be doing  

 The job holder of this position is responsible for leading the Finance function within the Country

Management Vertical in Egypt, while ensuring coordination with both respective Managing

Director of the Country, and Heads of Finance of Country Management (CM) and Managed

Companies (MCs) Verticals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee the operations of the Finance Department, provide expertise, encourage teamwork and facilitate related professional work processes to achieve high performance standards and staff pride in contribution.

  • Monitor the yearly budget of Finance Department and control expenditure to ensure optimal use.

  • Lead the completion and consolidation of monthly management reporting of Egypt, for the Captains of the different businesses included in the CM and MCs Verticals, highlighting key performance and finance indicators, variance versus budget and defining and tracking corrective actions plans to be implemented by each BU.

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of finance members responsible for financial control of individual BUs cross-country within the CM vertical.

  • Work with HR to ensure appropriate training programs are delivered to all members of the community and monitor key staff progress towards earning appropriate Finance qualifications.

  • Lead and manage, in liaison with key stakeholders in MCs, CM, and Services verticals, the formulation and strategic review process for Egypt with reference to: 3 YRS plan, the annual budget and (Re)-Forecast submissions coordinating with all Subverticals Finance Managers to ensure deliverables for the verticals and country are timely and accurate.

  • Act as the business partner for respective Captains in CM and MCs verticals within Egypt, ensuring also his/her finance team grant on-going support to the commercial, and Support teams to ensure corrective action plans on both revenue and costs are timely implemented to correct any material variance vs budget in OP or cash flow.

  • Ensure implementation of a robust and enhanced internal control environment following central processes as defined by Group Finance and Internal Audit, to deliver efficiencies and Budget OP and ROCE.

  • Support MCs sub-verticals finance teams with conducting financial evaluations for business investment opportunities and CAPEX spending in Egypt, in line with Group Guideline set out by Corporate Finance Team.

  • Conduct regular balance sheet audits for the legal entities of Egypt, and have regular meetings with Central Accounting Team to driving and follow up on actions to maintain their cleanliness and health.

  • Act as a first point of contact and as an escalation point and liaison between Group Treasury and local banks in Egypt to ensure smooth treasury operations in line with Group guidelines.

  • Assign individual objectives for employee performance management purposes, manage performance, empower staff, and provide formal and informal feedback to support professional development and maximize performance.

What you’ll need to succeed  

  • Previous experience as a Senior Finance Manager in Cairo

  • Strong background in Retail or FMCG industry preferred

What we can offer you  

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality.  We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.  

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.  

Using GenAI in Your Application Process

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

 Ability to lead through ambiguity and make pragmatic trade-offs. 

 Executive-level communication and decision facilitation skills. 

 Outcome-oriented mindset with strong delivery discipline.

 Core medical system migration delivered on time and within agreed scope .

JOB TITLE 
Production Finance Manager | MAF Entertainment | Cinemas

 ROLE SUMMARY 
The Production Finance Manager is a vital part of the production team, responsible for financial oversight, budgeting, cost control, payroll processing, reporting, and compliance throughout the production lifecycle. This role requires strong technical accounting skills, knowledge of union payroll, taxes, and the ability to work in fast-paced, deadline-driven environments.

 ROLE PROFILE 
 Develop and manage production budgets, track costs and forecasts, produce weekly financial reports, and monitor overall studio budget including partner payments.
 Be present on set during production to oversee weekly payments and ensure real-time expense monitoring.
 Oversee crew payroll, manage petty cash, per diems, P-cards, and ensure adequate cash flow; handle banking setup and documentation.
 Process and code invoices and expense reports, reconcile accounts, and audit reimbursements for policy compliance.
 Maintain general ledger and trial balances, generate financial reports, support audits and tax filings, and ensure compliance with regulations and policies.
 Utilize industry-standard financial tools (e.g., Movie Magic, SAP, SmartAccounting), recommend process improvements, and maintain organized records.

 Deliver financial management for at least 5 productions annually, take on additional tasks as needed, and be willing to travel.

 8–10 years of production accounting experience in film, TV, or digital media; Bachelor’s in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA/CA/CAPPA is a plus.
 Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, VLOOKUPs, macros) and familiarity with production accounting software (e.g., Movie Magic, SmartAccounting, MediaWeb).
 Solid understanding of tax incentives, compliance across regions, and local currency managementespecially in Egyptian productions.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst
jobs.description:
Overview Of The Role: 

 The Senior Financial Analyst supports the Senior Finance Manager in managing corporate finance, treasury operations, and funding requirements of the Financial Services Division, which includes ten entities. This role requires robust financial analysis, stakeholder coordination, and the ability to manage multiple entities under a structured governance framework. Success is measured through accurate financial modeling, strategic funding execution, effective cash management, and measurable improvements in financial efficiency and risk management.
 
 What You Will Do: 

 Corporate Financing 
 Deliver robust, decision-ready financial models and consolidated projections to support strategic planning, funding execution, and cost optimization.
 Ensure accurate Direct Cash Flow (DCF) forecasts aligned with the annual budget and quarterly forecasts.
 Provide actionable performance analysis of Balance Sheet, Cash Flow, and funding costs with recommendations to optimize financial efficiency.
 Evaluate and support optimization of capital and funding structures to enhance returns and reduce funding costs.
 Assess funding impact of capital expenditure and provide managerial insights on portfolio changes.
 Support execution of funding transactions through coordination with the Global Treasury Centre (GTC).
 Monitor capital adequacy and liquidity to enable strategic decision-making.
 
 Treasury & Cash Management 
 Prepare and review bi-weekly cash flow forecasts ensuring stakeholder alignment and forecast reliability.
 Ensure compliance with debt limits and facility covenants, identifying potential breaches in advance.
 Drive liquidity optimization to enhance cash efficiency, exceed budget targets, and improve working capital.
 Maintain real-time visibility of cash positions for seamless operational funding and debt servicing.
 Optimize liquidity through intercompany funding structures and cash reallocation strategies.
 Coordinate with GTC on bank management and facility limits, enhancing treasury operations.
 Develop dashboards for real-time monitoring of facility utilization and funding cost drivers.
 
 Asset and Liability Management 
 Implement asset and liability strategies to optimize returns per ALCO guidelines.
 Prepare assessments of asset liability mismatches for ALCO reporting.
 Monitor capital, liquidity, and interest rate risks through risk analysis and stress testing.
 Assist in determining funding strategies and balance sheet optimization objectives.
 
 Policies and Procedures 
 Manage accounting procedures related to debt and equity funding.
 Support preparation of fiscal records, financial plans, and policies at the divisional level.
 Ensure compliance with relevant policies and regulatory guidelines.
 Prepare internal approvals related to funding and treasury activities.
 
 Governance, Financial Risk Control, Transformation 
 Develop SLAs to govern treasury activities with Business Units.
 Assist in ALCO policy development and compliance.
 Review documentation for compliance with DOA including banking mandates.
 Perform KYC duties and update documents with banks in consultation with relevant teams.

 Required Skills To Be Successful: 

 Robust financial analysis and modeling capabilities.
 Effective stakeholder management and communication skills.
 Proficiency in SAP BPC and Anaplan.
 Understanding of balance sheet risks and mitigation strategies.
 
 What Qualifies You For The Role: 

 Qualified in Finance and/or Accounting, with a preference for professional certifications such as MBA, ACCA, CA, CIMA, or CFA.
 2 to 5 years of experience in corporate finance, treasury, banking, or financial services.
 Understanding of financial markets, forex, and treasury accounting, including FX, liquidity, and financial instruments.
 Strong analytical and financial modeling skills with advanced proficiency in Excel and Power BI.

jobs.title: Senior Auditor - II
jobs.description:
• To ensure quality execution of audits in coordination with the Audit Manager and staff and conduct audit of systems and processes, reporting the degree of compliance and ensuring management is made aware of risk implementation gaps 
• Assist the Group Risk Management Function in specific risk and compliance initiatives for embedding a strong risk culture within ATG and ensuring compliance with Group Risk Management policies and procedures.

 Functional Roles and ResponsibilitiesAudit and Advisory

• Assist in the development of annual internal audit plan, by providing key inputs through identification and evaluation of the organization’s audit risk areas. 

• Support the management in finalization of the audit scope areas and development of detailed audit plan for the assigned area, based on the annual plan so as to ensure implementation and management of assigned audits.

• Communicate assigned tasks to the engagement team in a manner that is clear and concise ensuring high quality, accurate, and efficient results. 

• Review and evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls within the scope area and assess compliance with ATG’s policies and procedures.

• Identify and clearly define audit issues and root causes, recommend improvements to internal controls and business processes, ensure that corrective action plans are developed and implemented in a timely manner.

• Support the field auditors in executing the audit as per the plan and within the defined budget and in accordance with defined audit methodology. 

• Assist in reviewing the audit program, analysing findings and the supporting documents procured in support of the issues raised to prepare an accurate and authentic report.

• Review the list of the issues received from the field auditors and decide if any other area or related activities are required to be looked into so as to ensure that all aspects of the business have been covered and reflect a correct picture of the company’s commercial health

• Receive the response on the draft report from the concerned company, examine the same along with the Audit Manager and discuss with the client to reconcile the difference, if any. 

• Ensure end-to-end process reviews are conducted, collate and consolidate observations, finalize the draft audit report with the Auditee and present the report to the Audit management for their review and assist the Audit Management Team in finalizing the executive summary.
• Conduct special field audit on request of the operating companies or on the advice of the Audit Manager to thoroughly investigate the critical segment of the business, identify the weaker and problem areas and recommend measures for effective control
Risk and Compliance

• Assist the Head of Risk with select governance and risk initiatives, which caters to improvement in overall governance structure and risk culture within the organization.

• Contribute to the risk assessment process for relevant entities/projects and identification of risks with the aim to adequately manage or eliminate any risks that may result in property loss, injury, or legal liability.
• Identification of key risks and updating the same in the risk register.

• Assist risk owners in developing risk mitigation plans for risks identified to mitigate or improve control frameworks and assist them in ensuring implementation of the risk mitigation plans.

• Assist the Head of Risk in rolling out group-wide policies

• Assist in promoting risk management related best practices within the business.

• Guide and support peers to enhance performance and produce quality work, and ensure that they are continuously delivering at the highest level required

 Education/Certification and Continued Education
• Chartered Accountant (CA/ACCA/CPA) or Inter CA with a Post Graduate Degree in Accounting or Finance

• CIA qualification is an advantage

Years of Experience
• Minimum 5 to 8 years of experience in finance and accounts function with at least 3 - 5 years of experience in a Financial/Operational internal audit role

• Consultancy/ Compliance Risk experience in the UAE market would be an advantage

Knowledge and Skills
• Good knowledge of financials as well as system audit gained through formal training or work experience 

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills 

• High mathematical acumen 

• Attention to details and concern for quality 

• Ability to manage multiple projects

• Well-groomed with a pleasant personality 

• Exposure to a multicultural environment 

• Strong organization and follow up skills including the ability to handle competing priorities and meet all deadlines and commitments

Job Requisition ID: 178319 

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate. 

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day

 Overview of the Role 
 We are looking for a Manager – Process & Compliance to support the finance transformation agenda across Al-Futtaim Automotive’s UAE and overseas operations.

 In this role, you will work closely with Finance, IT, and business teams to support ERP enhancements, strengthen process governance, improve system adoption, and drive better controls across automotive business operations.

 The successful candidate will bring a strong finance process background, ERP understanding, analytical thinking, and the ability to work confidently with multiple stakeholders in a fast-moving environment.

 What You Will Do 
 
 Support the implementation and enhancement of ERP systems from a finance process and compliance perspective.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID: 180589 

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United A”rab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organisation to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate. 

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day. 
 
 Role Purpose 

 The Risk Manager supports the CRO in maintaining an independent and effective enterprise risk management function. The role identifies, assesses, monitors and reports material risks, promotes sound risk culture, and protects policyholders, solvency and the Company’s regulatory standing. 

 Regulatory Context 

 The role shall comply with applicable UAE insurance laws and CBUAE requirements, including the Risk Management and Internal Controls Regulation, related Standards and the Corporate Governance Regulation. 

 Key Responsibilities 

 Maintain the enterprise risk management framework, policies, risk taxonomy, risk register and committee governance. 

 Support the Company in setting risk appetite, limits and key risk indicators; monitor exposures and promptly escalate breaches. 

 Provide independent challenge on strategy, business plans, products, pricing, underwriting, claims, reserving, reinsurance, investments, outsourcing, technology and major projects. 

 Assess all material risks, including insurance, credit, market, liquidity, operational, conduct, regulatory, cyber, model, climate, concentration and emerging risks. 

 Coordinate the Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA), linking risk profile, strategy, business plan, capital, solvency and risk appetite. 

 Conduct stress, scenario and reverse-stress testing; report vulnerabilities and monitor management actions. 

 Provide timely reports on the risk profile, appetite utilisation, ORSA, stress tests, material events, breaches and remediation. 

 Maintain records of risk events, losses, near misses and control failures; oversee root-cause analysis and action closure. 

 Support accurate regulatory submissions and supervisory reviews. 

 Monitor regulatory developments and translate them into policies, controls and implementation actions. 

 Review control effectiveness and ensure risk acceptance is properly authorised and documented. 

 Coordinate with Compliance, Actuarial and Internal Audit while preserving each function’s independence. 

 Maintain complete and auditable risk records, models, assumptions and decisions. 

 Qualifications and Experience 

 Bachelor’s degree in risk management, actuarial science, finance, accounting, insurance or a related field; relevant postgraduate or professional qualification is preferred. 

 Typically 3-5 years of relevant experience, including at least 3 years in insurance industry. 

 Strong knowledge of UAE insurance regulation, ERM, ORSA, solvency and capital, stress testing, underwriting, reserving, reinsurance, investments and operational resilience. 

 Board-level reporting and regulatory engagement experience; strong judgement, analytical ability, professional courage and communication skills. 

 Fluent business English; Arabic is an advantage.

 Orient Insurance Company commenced operations in 1982 as a part of the reputed Al-Futtaim Group and has since recorded a progressively steady growth. With head office in Dubai, the company serves its clientele through an extensive branch network in Jebel Ali, Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah in UAE, Muscat in Sultanate of Oman, Riyadh in Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and Bahrain

jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities: 

 VAT Compliance & Regulatory Management 

 Review VAT computations, reconciliations and supporting schedules prior to submission to the tax authorities. 

 Perform detailed reviews of sales transactions, output VAT calculations and revenue reconciliations to identify compliance risks and reporting inaccuracies. 

 Review purchase transactions and input VAT recovery assessments to ensure compliance with recoverability rules and documentation requirements. 

 Oversee import and export VAT reconciliations, customs-related VAT treatments, reverse charge transactions and cross-border supplies. 

 Monitor changes in VAT legislation and assess their impact on existing business processes and reporting requirements. 

 Support tax authority audits, assessments, information requests, and investigations by preparing documentation and responding to queries. 

 Identify VAT risks and control gaps and implement corrective actions to strengthen compliance. 

 Operations Governance 

 Review and validate key VAT controls to ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements. 

 Monitor VAT-related KPIs, dashboards and compliance metrics. 

 Ensure timely closure of VAT exceptions, unresolved reconciliations and reporting discrepancies. 

 Drive standardization of VAT processes across entities, business units and jurisdictions. 

 Tax Technology, Automation & Process Improvement 

 Drive automation initiatives to improve VAT compliance, reconciliation, reporting and monitoring processes. 

 Partner with IT, Finance Transformation and external vendors to implement tax technology solutions. 

 Develop dashboards and analytical tools to improve visibility over VAT risks, compliance status and operational performance. 

 Reporting & Management Information 

 Prepare and present VAT compliance status reports, risk assessments and operational dashboards to senior management. 

 Monitor key performance indicators related to VAT compliance, filing accuracy, exception management and process efficiency. 

 Support leadership with insights and recommendations to strengthen tax governance and operational effectiveness.

 6–7 years of experience in GCC VAT, Indirect Tax compliance or Shared Services operations. 

 Strong knowledge of UAE VAT and exposure to KSA VAT regulations. 

 Experience managing outsourced service providers and large-volume VAT operations. 

 Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. 

 Prior experience with ERP systems such as Oracle or Microsoft Dynamics. 

 Exposure to VAT automation, Tax Technology and process transformation initiatives. 

 MBA Finance/ CA/ CMA/ ACCA (completed or part qualified)

Majid Al Futtaim Holding is the leading shopping mall, retail, communities, entertainment developer and operator in the Middle East, North Africa, and Central Asia regions. Associate – Finance | MAF Retail | Hypermarket UAE

The Associate – Finance is responsible for financial postings covering the areas, but not limited to, payables, payroll, asset and general ledgers to ensure that precise data are updated to the system and are properly executed in line with MAF Retail’s established financial accounting principles and procedures.

JOB TITLE 
Emirati Talent- Senior Associate, Commercial | Majid Al Futtaim Development 

 ROLE SUMMARY 
The Commercial Senior Associate will be expected to assist in the commercial aspects of a portfolio of projects across the asset classes of MAF Development and provide assistance to the Senior Commercial Managers reporting the commercial status of projects Senior Project Team and the respective Development Managers. The ideal candidate is to have strong commercial awareness and have a background as a Graduate / Chartered QS with relevant experience in preparing cost plans, procurement awareness. T he commercial aspect of the role focuses on cost management, financial analysis, procurement, and project coordination, rather than sales-related activities. 

 ROLE PROFILE Support the Delivery Team on all commercial aspects of projects, ensuring alignment with project objectives.
 Assist in project development through control documents and guidance from senior management and Project Managers.
 Contribute to project delivery strategies across design, construction, and where applicable, operations and maintenance.
 Support cost management activities including cost planning, reporting, change management, and contract close-out in coordination with the Delivery Team.

jobs.title: Executive - Accounts and Finance
jobs.description:
To support and manage financial operations, ensure accuracy in financial reporting, and maintain compliance with accounting standards, regulatory requirements, and internal controls. The role involves assisting in financial planning, reconciliation, and strategic financial management to enhance the organization's fiscal health and long-term sustainability. 
 Responsibility: 
 Accounting & Financial Reporting 
 Maintain and oversee general ledger accounts, journal entries, and reconciliations. 
 Ensure timely closure of books of accounts and preparation of financial statements. 
 Assist in financial reporting, including P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements. 
 Taxation & Compliance 
 Handle GST, TDS, and other statutory filings within deadlines. 
 Ensure compliance with tax laws, accounting standards, and regulatory requirements. 
 Assist in audits (internal, statutory, and tax) and resolve queries. 
 Accounts Payable & Receivable 
 Manage vendor payments, employee reimbursements, and expense tracking. 
 Oversee customer invoicing, collections, and credit control. 
 Reconcile bank statements, supplier accounts, and customer accounts. 
 Budgeting & MIS Reporting 
 Assist in preparing budgets, forecasts, and variance analysis. 
 Generate MIS reports for management decision-making. 
 Track financial KPIs and ensure cost control measures. 
 Treasury & Cash Flow Management 
 Monitor cash flow, fund allocation, and banking transactions. 
 Coordinate with banks for payments, loans, and other financial matters. 
 ERP & Process Improvement 
 Work on ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, Tally, etc.) for financial transactions. 
 Identify and implement process improvements for efficiency and accuracy. 
 Qualification: 
 The ideal Executive - Accounts & Finance - should have 3-4 years of experience in finance or accounting, including experience in a supervisory or managerial role. 
 Proficiency in financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting. 
 Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or a related field; CFA or CPA preferred. 
 Strong analytical, strategic planning, and decision-making skills. 
 In-depth understanding of financial principles, investment strategies, and regulatory compliance.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY 
 
 Emaar Hospitality Group, a premier global provider of enriching, personal and memorable lifestyle experiences. As an innovative, agile and influential leader in hospitality, Emaar Hospitality Group is a wholly-owned subsidiary of Emaar Properties PJSC, the developer of elegantly designed and exceptionally built property, malls and hospitality projects across the world. 
 
 Created in 2007, Emaar Hospitality Group owns and manages a portfolio of hospitality assets and brands including Address Hotels + Resorts, Vida Hotels and Resorts, in addition to serviced residences, leisure clubs, and a comprehensive portfolio of restaurants and spas. The group plans to introduce its brands in key gateway cities and destinations in Europe, India, China, Middle East and North Africa. Emaar Hospitality Group is also the Official Hotel and Hospitality Partner of Expo 2020 Dubai. 
 
 ABOUT THE FUNCTION

jobs.description:
About Jumeirah 
 Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates a portfolio of 31 exceptional properties across 13 countries in the Middle East, Europe, Asia, and Africa. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and since then the brand has become known for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels, and exclusive branded residences. Jumeirah is synonymous with Arabian luxury hospitality and the ability to craft distinctive, purposeful experiences for the world’s most discerning travellers. 
 About Jumeirah Olhahali Island: 
 Jumeirah Olhahali Island in the Maldives is a contemporary island retreat set in the crystal-clear waters of the Indian Ocean. Surrounded by natural beauty, the resort features a collection of beach and over-water villas blending modern design with Maldivian charm. Guests can enjoy curated wellness experiences, diverse dining options with ocean views, and a wide range of leisure activities, including water sports, a fitness centre, and an infinity pool. 
 
 About the Job: 
 An exciting opportunity has arisen for an Assistant Cost Controller to join the Finance team in Jumeirah Olhahali Island . 
 The main duties and responsibilities of this role include: 
 Assist in monitoring and controlling food, beverage, and operational costs.
 Verify and process supplier invoices, ensuring accuracy and compliance with company policies.
 Reconcile daily inventory transactions, including receipts, issues, transfers, and stock adjustments.
 Conduct regular physical inventory counts and investigate stock variances.
 Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly cost control reports for management.
 Ensure all purchases and inventory movements are properly recorded in the accounting system.
 Review menu recipes and standard costing to maintain accurate food and beverage costs.
 Coordinate with the Purchasing, Receiving, Stores, Kitchen, and Finance teams to ensure effective inventory control.
 Monitor wastage, spoilage, and stock usage, and recommend cost-saving initiatives.
 Support month-end closing activities, including inventory valuation and cost-related journal entries.
 Ensure compliance with internal controls, company policies, and audit requirements.
 Maintain accurate documentation and filing of all cost control records.
 Assist in implementing process improvements to enhance operational efficiency and cost management.
 Perform other duties assigned by the Cost Controller or Finance Manager.
 
 About You: 
 The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications: 
 Diploma or bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, hospitality management, or a related field.
 1–3 years of experience in cost control, inventory, or finance, preferably in the hospitality industry.
 Knowledge of inventory management and cost accounting principles.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and ERP/POS systems.
 Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
 Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
 Good communication and interpersonal skills.
 Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.
 
 About the Benefits: 
 At Jumeirah, we are dedicated to fostering a vibrant community where colleagues feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow. Our benefits package reflects this commitment by offering excellent accommodation, extensive sports and leisure facilities, alongside comprehensive healthcare, and opportunities for professional development. 
 Benefits include: 
 Supportive and inclusive work environment 
 Access to Learning & Development programmes and clear career pathways 
 Opportunities for internal mobility within our global network 
 Colleague discounts on food, beverage, and hotel stays worldwide 
 Company-provided shared accommodation 
 Comprehensive healthcare and life insurance coverage 
 Paid annual leave and flight from your home country 
 Meals and Laundry services 
 Rest and Relax vacation

The role also entails initiating transformation projects and continuous improvement initiatives that align with organizational objectives, fostering an adaptable and forward-thinking financial environment.

 Capacity to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

jobs.title: Manager - Internal Audit
jobs.description:
The job holder will be responsible for managing the scheduled internal audits, special projects across KSA under the supervision of Head of Internal Audit. This role will also require execution of assignment independently while managing the team for other assignments parallelly. Assignments should be executed in line with Annual Audit Plan to assess the design/ operational effectiveness of controls, safeguarding of assets, compliances, and efficiency of operations. 

 Audit Assignment Planning & Review (Monitoring of the assignments delivered by AMs/ Executives) 

 Plan the engagements in detailed manner with team members in line with the agreed scope of work for areas being audited (based on process discussions with auditees and previous audits being undertaken) . 

 Monitor the field work to ensure that team delivers the engagement within the specified timelines. 

 Thoroughly review the audit work program, supporting, working files, calculations, draft and final reports etc. 

 Audit work program should ensure adequate coverage for establishing: 
 
 Effectiveness of internal controls so that processes operate with operational and financial integrity, 

 Identification of improvement areas to enhance, simplify, automate controls as well as improve process efficiency, 

 Ensure safeguarding of assets and achievement of organizational objectives and 

 Compliance with laws and regulations. 

 Incorporate new methods, techniques, and tools in planning (as well as executing) audits. 

 Ensure appropriate and sufficient audit documentation for each assignment. 

 Audit Execution & Reporting (Execution of the individual assignments) 

 Executive audit assignments independently. Ensure timely and appropriate execution of audit while ensuring, 

 Adequate coverage of transactions (sampling as well as data analytics), 

 Deploying accepted tools and techniques to make audit process efficient and 

 Keeping in context materiality as well weaknesses observed in the process. 

 Highlight potential risks and quantify either value at stake or improvement potential wherever applicable. 

 Come up with recommendations that are value adding, practical and improve on current operations. 

 Write concise, clear reports with facts and explanations that are suitable for senior management while at the same time are very actionable. 

 Maintain audit standards, working papers and overall, a highly professional approach. 

 Follow-up and track implementation of the recommendations provided when they become due. 

 Audit Integrity & Standards 

 Ensure confidentiality. 

 Ensure adherence to the internal audit department’s SoPs and Policies for self and reportees. 

 Ensure compliance with the Internal Auditing Standards issued by IIA.

jobs.title: Senior Associate - IT Internal Audit
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE 
• Assist in executing the annual IT Audit Plan under the supervision of the line manager
• Assist in risk assessment, executing end to end IT Audit, and special assignments
 
Please note, this role is for a UAE national only

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Internal Audit organization set-up:

• Ensure compliance to the approved Internal Audit (IA) processes, policies and procedures during the execution of audit engagements
• Support line manager in administrative tasks such as periodic updates to management, organizing department files, and meetings etc.

Monitoring and reporting:

• Draft the Risk Assessment and Control Matrix for performing the audit engagement to ensure engagement deliverables meet the audit scope and objectives
• Participate in creating, reviewing and finalizing the internal audit engagements and reports ensuring that all engagement terms of • reference have been adequately responded to and are adequately documented
• Assist the line manager in gathering the data for preparing presentations/ materials for submission to the head of Internal Audit/ higher management where applicable

Audit execution:
• Conduct initial research on the subject matter to be audited to identify potential risks and controls
• Assist with audit kickoff meetings to discuss the scope (process review) with the concerned department(s)
• Identify the key processes in conjunction with the department 
• Develop the process flow of the current process the “As Is” to identify technology risk points and validate available controls
• Perform control design testing documentation and operating effectiveness testing
• Draft detailed report and executive summary for Line Manager’s review and final discussion with the department
• Conduct a follow-up the following year of the engagement on assess the status of action plans and submit the follow-up report
 
 
QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE

RELATED YEAR OF EXPERIENCE:
• 4-6 years of experience in IT Audit

FIELD OF EXPERIENCE:
• Big 4 Consulting or equivalent. Oracle and Salesforce audit experience is a plus

TECHNICAL AND INTERPERSONAL SKILLS
• Primary - Excellent in IT Audit procedures and analyzing internal control gaps for IT General Controls and Application Controls
• Secondary - Cybersecurity audit, Data analytics
• High proficiency in presentation and reporting skills is a must

QUALIFICATION
•   Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, engineering or Information Systems/ Technology
• Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA) or Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC) certification or equivalent

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organization to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate. 

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day

 Overview of the role: 

 Manage the Credit Control function by overseeing customer collections, receivables, and debt recovery activities to ensure healthy cash flow and effective credit risk management. The role is responsible for managing assigned customer portfolios, monitoring outstanding balances, driving timely collections, and maintaining strong customer relationships while ensuring compliance with company credit policies and procedures. The position plays a key role in optimizing working capital, minimizing overdue receivables and bad debt exposure, improving collection performance, and supporting business operations through effective financial governance and stakeholder collaboration.

 What you will do: 

 Manage a portfolio of customer and tenant accounts, proactively driving debt collection activities to minimize overdue receivables and reduce bad debt exposure.

 Engage with customers through phone, email, and written communication to negotiate payment solutions, resolve outstanding balances, and maintain positive client relationships.

 Assess customers' financial positions and recommend appropriate collection strategies, payment plans, and recovery actions in line with company policies.

 Monitor receivables performance, aging reports, Days Receivables Outstanding (DRO), and collection KPIs, identifying risks and implementing actions to improve cash collection.

 Maintain accurate customer account records, reconciliations, and collection activities within ERP and related systems, ensuring data integrity and compliance with contractual terms.

 Prepare and analyze credit control reports, customer liabilities, and collection trends to support business decision-making and continuous process improvements.

 Collaborate with internal stakeholders, Shared Services, Legal, and other business functions to resolve complex collection cases, billing queries, and accounts requiring escalated action.

 Ensure compliance with credit control policies, standard operating procedures, regulatory requirements, and month-end, quarter-end, and year-end reporting deadlines.

 Support management by preparing ad hoc reports, conducting customer balance reconciliations, and providing recommendations to strengthen credit control processes and financial governance.

 Build strong cross-functional relationships while delivering excellent customer service and balancing business objectives with effective debt recovery strategies.

 Required Skills to be successful: 

 3+ years of experience in Credit Control, Accounts Receivable, Finance, or Accounting, with experience managing customer collections, debt recovery, and receivables within a corporate environment.

 Proven experience in credit control, collections, customer account management, reconciliations, aging analysis, and reducing overdue receivables while maintaining strong customer relationships.

 Hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably SAP or Yardi, with the ability to manage financial records, customer accounts, and reporting efficiently.

 Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, large customer portfolios, and meet reporting deadlines.

 Experience supporting business operations through financial analysis, customer account reviews, billing support, and cross-functional collaboration.

 Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with corporate clients, high-net-worth individuals, and internal stakeholders.

 Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including experience managing large datasets, databases, and financial reporting.

 About Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate 
The real estate development and operations arm of Al-Futtaim, Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate is responsible for a multi-billion-dollar portfolio across MENA. With high-quality residential, business, retail, tourism, educational and healthcare developments, the master developer caters to the diverse needs of cities and communities in the region. From origination, conception, development, sales, procurement and construction of mega-projects and the leasing, operation and management of these projects after completion, Al-Futtaim Group Real Estate (AFGRE) has been developing and managing owned landbanks, unlocking the economic potential of the region and contributing to future development for more than 40 years. 
Our focus is to enable and invest in meaningful relationships to make our properties the best places to live and work, build additional products and services and enable partnerships to create true value to our customers throughout their entire experience with us.
AFGRE is responsible for master planning of all projects in its portfolio, including two large scale mixed use destinations: Dubai Festival City and Cairo Festival City.
